title: A Constructive Field of Infinitesimals: Chunk and Permeate Approach
summary: While intuitive, naïve infinitesimal reasoning is classically inconsistent, and rigorous nonstandard analysis relies on non-constructive machinery. We resolve this tension by constructing an explicit, totally ordered field $\mathbb{R}^{\mathbb{Z}_{<}}$ using only real sequences and Cauchy convolution. We model the combined real and hyperreal axioms via the Chunk and Permeate strategy, a paraconsistent technique that isolates contradictions without global collapse.
